controls.procedure: Use the complete GitHub issue body as the primary specification source, verify its exact hash and require the official coverage validator to map every canonical candidate.
controls.expected: A shortened or translated specification source cannot pass as the issue body and every canonical candidate remains represented in the closure.
controls.observed: The exact 346-line issue body hash is preserved on the current candidate and validate_specification_coverage.py reports READY for all 102 obligations.

controls.procedure: Exercise GET /api/installments through the authenticated router with a persisted future invoice of a manual card installment purchase.
controls.expected: The public API returns the correct future occurrence and canonical origin transaction rather than relying on repository-only fixtures.
controls.observed: The exact-head PostgreSQL integration run returned the second occurrence of three through the public installments API boundary.

controls.procedure: Use two deliberately distinct financial profiles and query profile A invoiceId through profile B before rechecking the target profile result.
controls.expected: The sibling profile is excluded with zero foreign rows and cannot influence the target profile occurrence.
controls.observed: The exact-head PostgreSQL integration test returned an empty result for the distinct sibling profile and one canonical row for the target profile.

controls.procedure: Inject a PostgreSQL trigger failure on Installment propagation during a card-purchase instrument edit and read back Transaction plus all Installment rows.
controls.expected: The edit rejects and no partial Transaction or Installment mutation survives the injected failure.
controls.observed: The exact-head integration test observed full rollback to the pre-edit transaction and three-installment schedule.

controls.procedure: Race two updates for the same installment purchase with deliberately different card instruments and reload the canonical purchase plus schedule.
controls.expected: Either contender may win, but every installment must equal the final Transaction instrument and no mixed schedule may remain.
controls.observed: The exact-head PostgreSQL integration test completed both parallel edits with all three Installment.cardInstrumentId values equal to the final Transaction.cardInstrumentId.
